lesson: Channel and conflict handling are inferred by intersecting native SQLite semantics (changes() excludes trigger work and reports only the last direct statement; total_changes includes trigger inserts; REPLACE counts delete+insert; IGNORE reports 0 on conflict; UPSERT reports 1) against every calibration receipt; a goal is answered only when all surviving family members agree.
scope: Disposable SQLite source with private stable (conflict handling, optional AFTER INSERT log trigger, channel) combination; predict channel or committed state for new sequences from receipts.
